lines.text: The clinic is open Monday to Friday.
saturday mornings also open for vaccines

contradictions.question: Can parents book on Saturday?
contradictions.truth: No; Saturday vaccines are walk-in only

lines.text: Parents can book up to 7 days ahead.
Parents can book up to 30 days ahead.

contradictions.question: How far ahead can parents book?

lines.text: Children up to 12 years can be booked.

contradictions.question: Up to what age can a child be booked?

lines.text: Parents can cancel up to 1 hour before the visit.
no cancellations online, they must call

line.text: The site should feel friendly for parents.

unclear.question: What makes the site friendly for parents?
unclear.truth: Plain words and buttons at least 44 px high

line.text: Show enough slots so parents can choose.

unclear.question: How many days of slots should show?

open.question: What does the booking confirmation show?
open.truth: Doctor, date, time, child name and booking code

open.topic: One parent booking for two children
open.question: Can one parent book for two children?
open.truth: One booking per child; two bookings in a row are allowed

open.question: Who sees the list of bookings?
open.truth: The front desk, through the admin page; no doctor logins
